why: Run L4 sub-run L4c's leftovers that no later run L4 area owns: cut-line items, test-quality items, live checks and design-doc lines for the session lead. The money-pause correctness items (WORK_STATE guard etc.) go to the separate l4c-workstate fix.

L4a-left-7: a critic review that meets the subscription's plan share is still a budget pause, not the credential stop 'share'.

l4-chat-answers: L4-chat-105 (a closed project's lessons reach the kept project), -109 (recall ranking golden set), the L4-chat-113 reply check (scrub or flag tool names), the L4-chat-101 code-run recall fallback, the L4-chat-104 'switch' Open link; L4a-left-6 (L4-creds-6 composed test), L4b-left-9 (dependenciesNextLine with the hands-off setting).

l4c-workstate fixup (82a8470): the Left-to-do reason allowlist keeps a free subject slot (up to 5 words) guarded by word lists; an unlisted hedge ('the visible ones') inside a subject that ends in a done word could still read as nothing left. Clause shapes are closed; subject words are not. Live check F-9 covers the real model's phrasings.
